title: Adaptive response shaping — PRD sketch and idea parking
content:
Problem statement:
- Customers want predictable, consistent outputs across deployments and model upgrades. Right now model-side quirks (verbosity, tone, hallucinations, structure) leak through and teams must add brittle post-processing in their app code.
- We should provide an opinionated, low-lift layer in Redwood to post-process / gate / rewrite responses at inference time so teams can rely less on ad-hoc client logic.

What is Adaptive Response Shaping (ARS)?
- A per-route configurable pipeline that can:
  1) enforce output constraints (max tokens, JSON schema enforcement)
  2) apply lightweight transformations (summarize, canonicalize, re-tone)
  3) run quality checks (hallucination heuristics, factuality heuristics, profanity/safety), and optionally re-run the model or fall back to a safer variant
  4) attach provenance metadata and corrective diff (what was changed and why)
- Goal: deterministic, auditable shaping with minimal added latency in common cases.

Examples / user stories:
- Product manager at fintech: "I need all KYC answers to be normalized to our taxonomy and to never output PII. If the model outputs PII, redact and re-request a shorter answer."
- Marketplace founder: "Enforce polite tone and a 2-sentence limit for seller responses. If length exceeded, compress and mark as compressed."
- Platform engineer: "When a model upgrade introduces a hallucination regression the route should automatically degrade to a prior model variant and flag the invocation."

High-level API ideas (draft):
- Route config snippet (yaml-like):
  response_shaping:
    enforce_schema: true
    schema_type: json_schema
    schema: '{"type":"object","properties":{"answer":{"type":"string"}}}'
    safety_filters: ["profanity","pii-detect"]
    fallback_policy: "retry-with-smaller-context"
    retries: 2
    rewrite_policies: ["summarize:condense-2", "tone:professional"]
    attach_diff: true

- SDK call example (pseudo):
  client.generate({model: 'rw-3-large', route: 'support-lifecycle'}).withShaping({schema, filters}).send()

Design considerations / constraints:
- Performance: We must keep 95th-percentile added latency < 40ms for common shaping paths (schema check + tone tag). Heavy operations (full re-run, external fact-check) should be async or incur explicit route-level SLO changes.
- Cost: Keep per-token overhead minimal. Prefer model-side prompting + small rewrite requests over multi-token-heavy re-runs where possible.
- Observability: Add explicit markers in trace/span to show shaping steps and decisioning. Dashboard: shaped_rate, fallback_rate, avg_extra_tokens, shaped_latency_p50/p95.
- Auditing: Store original text + final text + shaping decisions in per-invocation metadata when attach_diff=true. Might be a paid retention tier.

Acceptance criteria (first MVP):
- Route config supports: schema enforcement (JSON), simple profanity/pii filters, one rewrite policy (summarize:compress), and a fallback policy to use a pinned older model variant.
- Tracing logs show shaping steps for each invocation.
- UI: Console shows per-route shaped_rate and fallback_rate for last 7 days.
- Simple API for retrieving shaped diffs for an invocation id.

Rollout plan (phases):
- Phase 0 (experiment): internal-only feature behind feature flag. Wire a few internal test routes (support-lifecycle, docs-gen) and iterate. Measure latency and cost delta.
- Phase 1 (beta): opt-in for hosted customers. Add console toggles and per-route defaults.
- Phase 2 (GA): enable in Dedicated/Private with configurable SLO implications and storage retention settings.

Open questions / risks:
- Where to implement filters? (edge, runtime, or model prompting?)
  - Edge: fast, but limited capabilities.
  - Runtime: can access KV caches and more context, but adds overhead.
  - Model: safest for semantic transforms but costs tokens and is less deterministic.
- Re-run policy complexity: naive retry vs guided rewrite (prompt engineering to fix hallucination) — risk of loops and cost spikes.
- Compliance: storing original outputs may be sensitive; need retention controls and opt-out.
- Ownership and UX: how do we make it discoverable in the Console without confusing users (is shaping a "feature" or "middleware")?

Metrics to monitor:
- shaped_invocations_count
- shaped_latency_extra_ms_p50_p95
- fallback_rate
- retries_per_shaped_invocation
- shaped_cost_delta_per_1k_requests
- customer_impact_events (support tickets mentioning "unexpected rewrite")

Short-term TODOs (next 2 weeks):
- Spike: implement prototype that does schema enforcement + simple summarization via one extra model call. Measure latency/cost. Owner: Marco. Target: 7/25.
- Console mockups: minimal controls for enabling shaping on a route + toggle for "attach diffs". Owner: Priya. Target: 7/28.
- Draft RFC for API and retention implications. Owner: me (Isabel). Target: 8/04.
- Add JIRA RED-2345 and link to spike, include acceptance tests.

Notes to self / brain dump:
- Could integrate with Optimize to recommend when shaping would reduce cost (e.g., verbose responses that can be summarized).
- Consider a "shaping marketplace" of pre-built policies (tone, legal-safety, length, taxonomy-mapping) — paywalled templates.
- Potential synergy with rollouts: shaping could be enabled only on canary to detect regressions early.
- Must avoid magic transformations that alter contractual language for regulated customers. Provide strict mode that only redacts.

Slack threads / references to follow up:
- #prod-hosted-api: thread about hallucination fallbacks (link pinned)
- convo with legal about retention of originals (EOD 7/18)

Final: rough but actionable. Want to keep this in Drive as the working PRD skeleton. Next step: turn Spike into measurement doc and link here.

---
cruft / quick snippets:
- quick heuristic for PII detection: regexes + small on-device classifier (low latency)
- cheap rewrite heuristic: if length>target_tokens then call compress-prompt with system "compress aggressively, preserve meaning"
- flagging format: shaped_metadata: {"actions":["redacted_pii","compressed"], "policy_id":"ARS-v0"}  (store as json blob in traces)
